paragraphs: Rav Huna, son of Rav Yehoshua, [Berakhot 22b](https://www.sefaria.org/Berakhot.22b.11).
Rav Chinana, son of Rav Yehoshua, [Pesachim 110b](https://www.sefaria.org/Pesachim.110b.9).
Rav Nechemyah, son of Rav Yehoshua, [Moed Katan 19b](https://www.sefaria.org/Moed_Katan.19b.11).
Rav Shisha or Sheshet, son of Rav Yehoshua, [Pesachim 115a](https://www.sefaria.org/Pesachim.115a.2).[^1]

notes.text: Pesachim 110b calls the father Rabbi Yehoshua. Moed Katan also gives a version in which Nechemyah’s father is Rav Yosef. The last notice, with no side specified by Hyman, is on 115a in the consulted text and has Sheshet. Hyman also gives Shisha.
